Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse hon, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Phir yeh dekha ki neeche ka number same ho toh hisse ek size ke hote hain, aur upar ka number, yaani hisson ki ginti, faisla karta hai. Aakhir mein yeh dekha ki upar ka number same ho toh ginti barabar hoti hai, aur tab hisse ka size batata hai ki kaunsa zyada hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
